answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bonded to a single verified device key before it can trade. A reef of honest agents can then vouch for newcomers only after repeated successful work, so an attacker cannot spin up an island of fake identities for free: each copy must post its own stake and build its own reputation. If a fake is caught cheating, its stake is slashed and its endorsers lose part of theirs, making a haven for sockpuppets expensive to sustain rather than a cheap trick.
